lines:
Hierarchy-first design browser with tree navigation, C4 level controls, breadcrumbs, local UML and UI mockup artifact tabs, source panels, inspector, and traceability navigation between linked artifacts.

Implemented Markdown extension (2026-09-25; SQLite and text backends): Add a discoverable project-level Documents entry and Markdown artefact entries within linked architecture scopes; project documents need no invented C4 parent. Open task/QA/document links directly in an editable Markdown panel showing title, content and relevant associations/backlinks. Reuse the existing EasyMDE MarkdownEditor/VersionedMarkdownEditor in src/main.tsx (extract shared code if appropriate); preserve its formatting toolbar and Preview capability rather than adding a second editor library. Adapt draft guarding to canonical design readTokens. Support create, edit, preview, rename title, associate, detach and guarded delete; show saving/saved/error/conflict states with accessible keyboard navigation. Keep raw agent-generation notices out of the canonical editable body. Preserve drafts during polling, navigation, backend changes, conflicts and failed saves; no cleanup/unmount autosave may overwrite or resurrect discarded/deleted content. Reuse the application's rendering/link policy and prevent executable HTML or unsafe URL navigation. Show official documents in task/QA pickers and backlinks; open stable typed identities, not file paths.

Verification (2026-09-25): Markdown tasks 25-36 implement this extension on the available SQLite and text adapters. Common contracts, actual stdio MCP, native Tauri/WebView2, conversion, independent Git clones and generated-file checks are recorded in task 36, QA jobs 6/7 and docs/markdown-validation.md. Generated files remain derived and agent authoring uses MCP. Server SQL implementation and validation remain pending in storage tasks 20-23.

Implemented design-workspace integration (2026-09-29; desktop frontend, task 34): The design index lists one kind of thing at a time: Tree View (the C4 tree, starting collapsed, opening only the branch of the element shown in the viewer and leaving every other branch as the user left it, followed by the UML, mockup and Markdown artifacts attached nowhere in the tree), Components, UML Artifacts, UI Mockup and Documents. The shared index search filters whichever listing is shown. A Markdown document renders inside the design viewer panel, so the header above it keeps the tree breadcrumb, the panel keeps the background and heading style of every other view, and opening a document does not change the index listing; task and QA jumps open the Documents list. While a document is open the inspector column shows that document (Design Document, Related designs, Referenced by) with the inspector markup the element and relationship panels use, instead of another entity, and the element and relationship inspector keep listing the documents connected to the shown entity. The Markdown editor opens on its rendered preview and scrolls inside its own box, so text longer than the box stays reachable. Verified with `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build`; manual GUI checks remain with the user.
